termination_reason: Voluntary resignation to return to full-time study
termination_observations: Reliable on the shop floor and quick to cover shifts. Resigned to return to full-time study; notice served in full.

termination_reason: Dismissed for repeated breaches of the store conduct rules
termination_observations: Two written warnings for repeated breaches of the store conduct rules, the second after a cash handling incident. Dismissed without notice.

termination_reason: Role withdrawn after the shift pattern was redesigned
termination_observations: Steady but never above expectations, and the role disappeared when the North Shop shift pattern was redesigned. Notice served in full.

termination_reason: Dismissed after repeatedly missing agreed targets
termination_observations: Below the agreed targets in every review cycle worked, with no progress after two coaching rounds. Fifteen days of notice were not served by the company.

termination_reason: Voluntary resignation after relocating with family
termination_observations: Consistently one of the strongest of the South Shop crew. Resigned after relocating with family; notice served in full and rehire recommended.

termination_reason: Voluntary resignation while on a performance improvement plan
termination_observations: Resigned while the improvement plan agreed with the store manager was still open. Ten days short of the contractual notice period, discounted in the final settlement.

termination_reason: Voluntary resignation to join a competitor
termination_observations: Top performer who resigned for a larger role at a competitor. Notice served in full and a counter offer was declined.

termination_reason: Dismissed after a sharp decline in performance
termination_observations: Solid reviews until last year, then a sharp decline in sales and reliability confirmed by the latest cycle. Seven days of notice were not served by the company.
Two consecutive review cycles below expectations and an improvement plan closed without progress. Notice served in full.

termination_reason: Role eliminated by the store network consolidation
termination_observations: Strong performer whose position disappeared when the North Shop team was merged into a single store crew. Notice served in full and outplacement support offered.

termination_reason: Voluntary resignation for a new career opportunity
termination_observations: Resigned to join another company. Left five days short of the contractual notice period, discounted in the final settlement.

termination_reason: Role made redundant after regional restructuring
termination_observations: Position removed by the regional restructuring plan. Notice served in full and severance agreed with the works council.

termination_reason: Mutual agreement following an employee relocation
termination_observations: Closed by mutual agreement after the employee relocated; the fixed-term contract was not renewed. No notice period owed.
